summary: Candidate 'D3 Scale Type Selection and Configuration' represents a distinct semantic capability—general scale type selection and configuration across all D3 scale families (linear, time, log, ordinal, band, sequential, diverging, quantile, quantize, threshold). The existing 'Sequential Scale Configuration' skill is narrowly scoped to sequential variants only and operates at a different granularity (micro-step within scale configuration). The candidate operates at session level with broader workflow scope. No existing skill covers the full scale-selection decision tree. Peer candidates operate at different stages (planning, rendering) and task families. Create as new session-level skill to provide comprehensive scale selection guidance.
